content.value: Suppose, interrupts TF1, INT0 and INT1 of 8051 microcontroller are activated at the same (09) time. Assume that after reset, the interrupt priority is set by the instruction MOV IP, # 00011000B. Discuss the sequence in which the interrupts are serviced after setting this value to IP register of 8051 microcontroller.
